description: A random voltage generator: one trigger draws five independent random voltages and holds them, each through its own attenuverter

params.text: Selects unipolar output, 0-10V, or bipolar, -5V to +5V
Adds the slow fall of an analogue sample and hold to the held voltages
Scales the random voltage on its own output, -1 to +1, inverting it below zero

inputs.text: A rising edge draws a fresh random voltage for every output; the channel count of this input sets the polyphony

outputs.text: A random voltage held until the next trigger, drawn independently of every other output

notes: nothing comes out until a trigger is patched; the trigger input sets the channel count, and with it unpatched every output is silent
